before.lua_content:
-- name: #Dain_Frostreaver_IV
-- Generated by scripts/quests/coldain-rings.mjs; edit coldain_rings.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Coldain_Ring_Quests (sha256 4881b2816d5a485629a66855b1a4f44c7048899b5e9240b4bf068a9373384851)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/thurgadinb/#Dain_Frostreaver_IV.pl (sha256 0deaf61a0f53a296b28548ab57dd5901b6d3ce4e792aba66a13ec1faef9b3423)
-- First seven rings, eighth-ring orders and ninth-ring final Give; encounter status: docs/coldain-quest-chains.md.
-- The ninth-ring final exchange, tenth-ring invitation and repeatable Dain blessing exchange are restored. Ring10 war/boss/reward acquisition and other Dain quests remain unfinished; a seeded final ring is not earned-chain evidence.
-- P99 establishes the two requirements and two rewards; experience and faction amounts retain the preserved ProjectEQ ninth-ring branch. Later eighth-shawl branches are excluded.
-- The cached P99 page documents a shared, snipable invitation lasting slightly less than one minute. IdleQuest uses an expiring NPC/zone-scoped shared flag with a 60-second upper bound; this small timing approximation is explicit, and atomic flag validation prevents double claims.
-- Repeatable ring10 blessing follows https://wiki.project1999.com/10th_Coldain_Ring_Quest (cached SHA256 bc93e3ab34ecef5d2d0b8ebce2adc95a0639925f67281f055804e18d46b21add). Return the ring and grant Protection of the Dain. Quest faction is intentionally bypassed; no undocumented XP or faction reward is added.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("count on my help") and eq.get_qglobals()["coldain_ring10_invitation"] == "1" then
    e.self:Say("Several of our greatest officers, including a few veterans from the war of Yesterwinter are assembling just outside our city. Gather your army at once and give this parchment and the ninth ring to Sentry Badain. I will remain inside the city with a few of my troops to defend it against any who might penetrate your defense. May Brell be with you, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ".")
    eq.del_global("coldain_ring10_invitation")
    e.other:SummonItem(1567)
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 1500, item2 = 30164 }) then
    e.self:Say("The people of Thurgadin are in your debt, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". Please accept the Coldain Hero's Ring as a token of our gratitude. The curse has been removed from the blade as well. I hope you find it useful against our common foes. When you are interested in assisting me further please show me the blade. Until that day, may Brell bless and protect you.")
    e.other:SummonItem(30369)
    e.other:SummonItem(1465)
    e.other:Faction(406, 50, 0)
    e.other:Faction(405, 50, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, -50, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -50, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(4000000)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 1465 }) then
    e.self:Say("My good " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ", you have served me well. You have flushed out all who sought to oppose me and my people. I am afraid I need to call upon you and your friends one final time. The dissension and treason ran deeper than I had anticipated. Our population has been cleansed, but we lost a full third of our army to the poisonous words of those rebels. In retaliation for your deeds, the Kromrif have made plans to attack us in this, our weakest hour. Can I count on your help, outlander?")
    e.other:SummonItem(1465)
    eq.set_global("coldain_ring10_invitation", "1", 2, "S60")
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 30385 }) then
    e.self:Say(e.other:GetCleanName() .. ", your deeds have changed the fate of my people forever. Not since the sacrifice of Colin Dain himself has anyone so selflessly risked so much for our well being. Accept this blessing as a token of my gratitude.")
    e.other:SummonItem(30385)
    e.other:SummonItem(1747)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
